contracts: (A timeout/output-limit failure is observed and coverage digest is unchanged.) AND (Any dependency fingerprint mismatch yields stale and prevents trusted Replay Result production.) AND (Any root-escaping validator yields identity-invalid and no trusted Replay Result.) AND (The isolated blob-comparison fixture deterministically rejects a byte mismatch and verifies unchanged historical bytes.)
selector_intents: Dependency-mutation fixture fails before dependency fingerprints affect freshness classification.
Root-escape fixture fails before permitted-root containment enforcement.
Run the timeout-fixture selector and fail if no bounded timeout/output-limit result is observed.
Select the blob-comparison fixture with altered historical bytes and require the validator to fail the attempted write.
